scope: All11-article book; independent visual, textual and link/provenance checks. No canonical edits.
criteria: Inspect contact sheets covering every final PDF page; log page ranges actually seen.
Inspect full-size selected Odia titles and paragraphs for shaping, missing glyphs, clipping and spacing.
Inspect cover, contents, chapter starts/ends, headers/folios, image/caption placement and endnotes for readability, stranded headings and awkward breaks.
Compare image framing and quality to retained sources; real photographs not silently cropped/retouched and synthetic illustrations explicitly labelled.
Verify credits/licence links and source notes survive; sample internal contents/chapter/endnote links.
Compare book text against all11 canonical sources; editorial transitions must introduce no new unsupported historical claims or change attributed statements into author verdicts.
After any substantive correction, inspect affected final rerendered pages and bind approval to actual final PDF SHA.
limits: Read-only review of this specific final75-pagePDF; not print-proof inspection or browser QA.
No new film viewing, comprehensive history claim, independent copyright clearance or public publication approval.
Recorded source/research and legacy image-provenance limits remain; book note makes synthetic imagery and contextual photographs distinct.
